checks.detail: g_rho, g_s of the Standard Model: 10000 GeV: 106.75/106.75, 300 GeV: 106.38/106.23, 50 GeV: 97.43/96.56, 5 GeV: 85.60/85.37, 1 GeV: 76.35/75.51, 0.2 GeV: 62.24/62.02, 0.1 GeV: 17.37/17.02, 0.01 GeV: 10.76/10.76, 0.001 GeV: 9.49/9.63, 1e-05 GeV: 3.36/3.91; above the electroweak scale 106.75 (three right-handed neutrinos in equilibrium would add 5.25), 10.75 between the muon and electron thresholds, today g_s = 3.909, g_rho = 3.363

checks.name: T2_relic_density
checks.detail: Omega_chi h^2 = 0.1200 from the numerical solution of FE-61 for an s-wave annihilation requires <sigma_ann v> = 2.31e-26 (10 GeV), 2.19e-26 (30 GeV), 2.17e-26 (100 GeV), 2.25e-26 (300 GeV), 2.28e-26 (1000 GeV), 2.26e-26 (3000 GeV), 2.31e-26 (10000 GeV) cm^3/s (FE-61 normalisation, n_chi with g_chi = 8; (sigma v)_{chi chibar} is four times larger) with freeze-out at x_f = 23.1, 24.0, 25.1, 26.2, 27.4, 28.4, 29.6; the analytic estimate of FE-61 agrees within 25%

checks.name: T3_current_portals
checks.detail: a thermal relic through the quark current portals has sigma_SI = 1.1e-38, 1.3e-39, 1.3e-40, 1.5e-41, 1.3e-42, 1.5e-43, 1.4e-44 cm^2 (10, 30, 100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000 GeV), above the LZ limit by factors 2e+07, 9e+05, 2e+04, 9e+02, 2e+01 for 100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000 GeV (below 40 GeV the measured limit rises steeply and no comparison is made): the quark portals cannot set the relic density from 100 GeV to 10 TeV (their couplings must be smaller than the relic value by the square roots of these factors); through the lepton portals (9 chiral states) the scattering is loop-induced, sigma_SI = 2.8e-43 (10 GeV), 5.4e-44 (30 GeV), 7.7e-45 (100 GeV), 1.3e-45 (300 GeV), 1.6e-46 (1000 GeV), 2.2e-47 (3000 GeV), 2.6e-48 (10000 GeV) cm^2 per nucleon, above the limit below about 1454 GeV and allowed above (ESTIMATE: the loop cut-off Lambda = omega_b and the scaling of the LZ limit enter): a leptophilic chi of a TeV or more can be the thermal relic

checks.name: T4_higgs_portal_binding
checks.detail: the Higgs-portal Yukawa coupling of FE-47, g_hchi = -2 q_b^2/(omega_b v), gives sigma_SI = mu_N^2 (g_hchi f_H m_N/(v m_h^2))^2/pi; LZ then requires |g_hchi| < 3.1e-03, 5.3e-03, 9.7e-03, 1.7e-02, 3.1e-02 and q_b/omega_b < 0.062, 0.047, 0.035, 0.026, 0.019 for omega_b = 100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000 GeV (ESTIMATE): the dark-matter particles chi must be weakly bound to the fold

checks.name: T5_right_handed_neutrinos
checks.detail: the Yukawa production of nu_R is negligible (Gamma/H ~ 5e-09 at 100 GeV); through the portal they decouple at x_dec = 13.4, 14.0, 14.6, 15.2, 15.8, 16.4, 17.0 and add Delta N_eff = 0.236, 0.199, 0.188, 0.182, 0.155, 0.143, 0.141 (FE-62), i.e. N_eff = 3.28, 3.24, 3.23, 3.23, 3.20, 3.19, 3.18 against Planck 2018 2.99 +- 0.17 (pulls 1.7, 1.5, 1.4, 1.4, 1.2, 1.2, 1.1) and ACT DR6 with BBN 2.89 +- 0.11 (pulls 3.5, 3.2, 3.1, 3.1, 2.8, 2.7, 2.7): the right-handed neutrinos must not thermalise (c^nu << c^l, then N_eff = 3.044)
